Dp.bar_b_note: The Stormcapra model itself (white fleece, dark ram horns, blue accents) matches the owner style bar and would pass beside Palworld, but it is staged on a flat grey stage with no atmosphere, and side B's faint mid/end sink the body into the floor with the horns lying loose, which sinks the read.

Ql.bar_b_note: Side B's panel is legible with a sound blue-grey/gold hierarchy, but the hint glyphs are generic keyboard icons with no teal emphasis and the world behind is a murky flat night with no light or depth, so it does not reach Palworld's HUD finish.

It.bar_b_note: Side A's furred boar is close to the naturalistic bar but carries odd yellow blob spots and floats above its shadow in faint mid, and side B is a smooth terracotta clay toy off the owner style; in both the boar stands no taller than the 1.80 m trainer.

Dh.bar_b_note: The craft panel itself is clean (full material lines, Missing tags, need-N-more, teal Leave) and fits the UI direction, but the small orange preview text and the plain blurred meadow behind keep it short of Palworld's HUD and world finish.

Fc.bar_b_note: Same result as Dh: recipe names and material lines are complete and the hierarchy is clear, but the preview lines are small orange-on-teal text and the backdrop has no Valheim-class light or atmosphere.

Ur.bar_b_note: The white-haired elder in moss-green vest, scarf and brown boots has an appealing, clean face and readable full-body silhouette on a par with Palworld humans, though the big-eyed cartoon face is more stylised than the naturalistic creature bar.

top_changes.change: Bring every creature above the 1.80 m trainer and to the owner style bar: replace the clay-toy boar (It B) and fix the gold-blob fur pattern (It A) with a naturalistic furred, mossy boar mesh/material per the Mudsnout/Tuskroot board.

Fix faint poses so the body stays on the ground plane and in one piece: no floating above its shadow (It A faint mid), no sinking through the floor with detached horns (Dp B faint mid/end), no tangled legs through the torso (Dp A faint end).

Unify the craft panel on the Dh/Fc layout across resolutions: larger material preview text with better contrast than orange-on-teal, controller-first teal Craft/Leave prompts instead of keyboard glyphs (Ql B), and no truncated lines (Ql A).
